correctness.rationale: For any infinite Γ select a countable ray and isometric right-shift S on ℓ∞(Γ) with a one-coordinate defect; its left inverse L obeys LS=I, SLv=v-v(γ1)e. Direct substitution reconstructs both compositions of Tλ and its inverse on E=M⊕Y and product ω. Disjoint support proves ||P_M Tλ^n(m+y,w)||=max(|λ|^n||m||, max_{1≤j≤n}|λ|^{n-j}|w_j|). For |λ|>1 every nonzero forward orbit enters the fixed Banach seminorm threshold, so positive and hence two-sided metric expansivity. For 0<|λ|≤1 the orbit of e at all positive and negative times has seminorm ≤1; arbitrarily small scalar multiples refute a uniform expansive constant. Finite Γ gives ℓ∞(Γ)⊕ω≅ω, and published nonexpansivity of ω excludes any expansive automorphism. This holds for the given family λ≠0 over R or C; finite-support tests alone do not prove infinite dimensions.
